summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of mask propagation in arithmetic operations, but it may introduce behavioral regressions and lacks comprehensive tests.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new condition where if either operand has a mask of None, it copies the other operand's mask. This could potentially break existing behavior where None masks were handled differently.
The patch does not include additional tests to verify the correctness of the new mask handling logic in various scenarios, increasing the risk of future regressions.
